settingsScreen.text11: Ezali na makoki te ya kobomba mongongo ya kobenga. Meká lisusu.
settingsScreen.text12: Ekoki te ko charger ba préférences. Fungola lisusu Paramètres.
settingsScreen.text13: Momekano eumelaka segɔnde misato. Ezali mpe kobongisa volime ya telefone. Kosimba oyo esalelamaka na application efungwami; libanda na yango, activer ba alertes ya appel oyo ezali awa na se.
settingsScreen.text15: Ezwi liyebisi libanda ya KOSOLOLA. Finá na alerte mpo na kofungola appli mpe koyanola ntango kobenga ezali kobɛta.
settingsScreen.text16: Ko vérifier ba alertes na appareil oyo...
settingsScreen.text17: Kota mpo na ko activer ba alertes.
settingsScreen.text18: Mayebisi ekangami. Tika mayebisi uta na KOSOLOLA na ba paramètres ya téléphone to ya navigateur na yo mpe finá Meka lisusu.
settingsScreen.text19: Service ya alerte ezali kaka ko configurer.
settingsScreen.text22: Bokanga ba alertes na dispositif oyo
settingsScreen.text25: Ba alertes actives na dispositif oyo.
settingsScreen.text26: Ba alertes ezo respecter mode Ko déranger te na ba permissions ya téléphone. Bazali kosenga internet mpe ba remplacer sonnerie ya appel native te.
settingsScreen.text27: Mosala ya likebisi ezali te. Finá na Meka lisusu.
settingsScreen.text30: Ba sessions oyo epesami ndingisa na YAMILOOK na KOSOLOLA.
settingsScreen.text31: Mikolo ya sika ya ba dispositif
settingsScreen.text40: Kokanga accès epekisaka bozongisi sika ya session wana. Mokanda ya bondimi oyo esi epesami ekoki kotikala na nguya kino ekosila.
settingsScreen.text41: Ekoki te ko consulter ba sessions. Confirmer connexion pe meka lisusu.
settingsScreen.text45: MVP: Ba messages na ba appels esalela service ya Yamilook. Ba alertes hors app esengaka activation na appareil oyo. Encryption ya suka na suka esalemi nanu te.
settingsScreen.text46: Bokoti ebimaka kaka na installation oyo ya KOSOLOLA. Masolo ebombamaka na compte na yo.
settingsScreen.text47: Na iPhone to iPad, salelá Partager → Bakisa na Écran d’accueil mpe fungola KOSOLOLA na elembo mpo na ko activer ba alertes.
settingsScreen.text48: Efungoli KOSOLOLA na nzela ya boyokani HTTPS mpo na kofungola makebisi.
settingsScreen.text49: Ezali kosala mikolo oyo iPhone to iPad na iOS 16.4 to ya sika mpe efungoli KOSOLOLA uta na elembo na écran monene.
settingsScreen.text50: Navigateur oyo esimbaka te ba alertes ya kobenga. Esalelaka navigateur oyo ebongwani na lisungi ya mayebisi.
settingsScreen.text51: Ekoki te kokutana na service ya alerte. Meká lisusu.
settingsScreen.text52: Mikolo oyo KOSOLOLA mpe meka lisusu.
settingsScreen.text53: Tika mayebisi na ba paramètres ya dispositif ezwa ba alertes.
settingsScreen.text54: Ekoki te kopekisa makebisi na dispositif oyo.
settingsScreen.text55: Kotala mpo na makebisi ezwaki ntango molai mingi. Etalaka boyokani mpe ebɛtaka Meka lisusu.
